summary: Backend-only regression/bug-fix verification for BRK Faturas 'Débitos Visualizado' tracking. Created /app/backend/tests/test_debitos_visualizado.py (7 pytest tests, all PASS). Confirmed: (1) POST /api/public/gerar route is registered - returns 503 'Pagamento indisponível' due to missing chave_pix (NOT 404/405), so the accidentally removed decorator is restored. (2) MAIN BUG FIXED: two POST /api/public/lead calls with the SAME session_id now create 2 'Débitos Visualizado - Usuário {documento}' activities (dedup is now scoped only to fatura creation, activity logging happens before dedup return). (3) The activity is enriched with location (IP geoloc via ip-api.com: 8.8.8.8 -> 'Ashburn, Virginia, United States'), device (desktop) and so (Windows). (4) Regression /public/acesso home still increments click counter + records location/so/device. (5) /faturas list loads; dashboard/clicks rows carry location/device/so/created_at. (6) Auth guard on /activities returns 401/403.
critical_code_review_comments: chave_pix is not configured in settings, so /public/gerar returns 503 for real users - the full PIX generation path (200 with pix_code) could NOT be exercised end-to-end. If PIX must work in this environment, configure settings.chave_pix. Route presence is confirmed; happy-path logic was only code-reviewed, not executed.

geolocate() still does a synchronous external HTTP call to ip-api.com (free tier ~45 req/min) on every /public/lead and /public/acesso; adds latency and a third-party dependency - consider caching by IP (noted in prior iterations).

activity logging in /public/lead fires on every request regardless of session dedup (correct per the fix intent), but there is no throttling, so repeated/automated lead posts with the same documento will flood the activities feed - acceptable for the reported requirement but worth noting.

Both new test files (test_acesso_tracking.py, test_debitos_visualizado.py) pass.
rca of the issue: Reported bug: public user viewed débitos but panel did not log 'Débitos Visualizado'. Root cause: the 'Débitos Visualizado' (acesso_faturas) activity creation in /public/lead was coupled to fatura dedup - if the session already had a fatura, the endpoint returned early and never logged the activity. Additionally the @api.post('/public/gerar') decorator had been accidentally removed, leaving PIX generation without a route. Fix verified: activity is now logged BEFORE the fatura dedup return (so it fires every time, confirmed 2x for same session_id), enriched with location/so/device; and /public/gerar is routed again (503 due to missing chave_pix, not 404/405).
